text:
jamie: Quick heads up — I have a passport appointment tomorrow at 14:00 PT and need to leave the office by 13:30. I’m oncall for the 12:00–20:00 PT block, so I need someone to cover roughly 13:30–17:30 PT. Sorry for the short notice :grimacing:

priya: I can take 14:00–18:00 PT if that helps, but I have a 16:30 sync. I can stay until 18:00 and pair with whoever picks up 18:00–20:00.

matt: I can flip my evening slot earlier and cover 18:00–20:00 PT. So if priya takes 14–18, jamie leaves at 13:30, handoff in #eng-oncall around 13:15?

jamie: Thanks both. Handoff plan: meet in thread at 13:15 PT for quick state. Two quick FYIs —
- We have a small model tuning rollout scheduled at 15:30 PT (non-prod first, but prod can see transient latency).
- Cache warmup steps matter after that deploy.

I’m pasting the minimal runbook snippet to check basic health during handoff:```
# check api health
curl -sS https://api.redwood.example/health | jq .status
# check request latency (last 5m) - internal metrics link
open https://console.redwood.example/dashboards/latency?range=5m
# restart worker group if errors spike (use infra privileges)
redwoodctl restart worker-group oncall-pool
```

Also, when the 15:30 tuning runs, watch for: token throughput drop, increased 95th pct latency, and kv-cache miss rate bump. If anything spikes: 1) add the oncall pager to the model-fallback policy, 2) rollback to model v2.14 via console, 3) escalate to eng-sre.

priya: Got it. I’ll join 13:15 PT handoff. I’ll also pre-warm the cache from 15:00–15:20 by sending the standard warmup prompt set (I’ll run the script).

matt: I’ll be available at 18:00 handoff and can keep the calendar invite updated. Jamie's calendar — can you forward the invite to priya and me so it shows the swap?

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout "model-tuning-2026-03-18" queued for 2026-03-18T22:30:00Z (15:30 PT). Notifying oncall channel.

jamie: Invite updated and forwarded to @priya and @matt. Quick note for priya: warmup script is at repo/tools/warmup.sh — run `./warmup.sh --suite small` from the runner host. If you hit rate limits, drop to --suite tiny.

priya: Copy that — will run at 15:00 and report back in this thread once warmed (:thumbsup:).

jamie: Thank you! Really appreciate the cover. I’ll leave a short sticky in the incident docs with the model flags I changed. Handoff confirmed: priya 14:00–18:00 PT, matt 18:00–20:00 PT.
